description: This file is a shell script used for testing git's diff and merge behavior with binary and text files, including handling of binary diffs, text conversions, and attributes. It sets up various merge conflicts, tests diff outputs, and verifies the correctness of diff formats under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified attributes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
